902256344.description: This Kaihalulu Beach is on Oʻahu’s northeastern North Shore, east of Turtle Bay near the Marconi shoreline; it is unrelated to the red-sand Kaihalulu Beach near Hāna on Maui.

sources.name: Kauhala and nearby Kaihalulu coast map

902256345.name: Turtle Beach
902256345.description: This Turtle Beach is a mapped beach at Turtle Bay (Kukaeʻohiki) on Oʻahu, effectively co-located with the separate Turtle Bay Beach database entry. Do not confuse it with Laniākea Beach, also popularly called Turtle Beach.
amenities: Nearby Turtle Bay resort-area public shoreline access; check designated entry route

sources.name: Turtle Bay beach coordinates and alternate name

902256348.name: Hanaka‘ilio Beach
902256348.description: Hanakaʻilio Beach is a secluded, mostly undeveloped shoreline on the northeast Oʻahu coast near Turtle Bay.

902256349.name: Kauhala
902256349.description: Kauhala is a mapped gravel beach on Oʻahu’s northeast North Shore, near the Marconi area and east of Turtle Bay. Its shoreline and name are established by geospatial mapping, but official visitor facilities or an access route have not been established.

902370052.name: Moku‘Auia Beach
902370052.description: Mokuʻauia Beach is a sand-and-reef coastline on Mokuʻauia (Goat Island) offshore from Mālaekahana on northeastern Oʻahu.

902536680.name: Clissolds Beach
902536680.description: Clissolds Beach is a sandy beach area near Lāʻie on windward Oʻahu.

902536689.name: Kaipapa‘U Beach
902536689.description: Kaipapaʻu Beach is a small shoreline location near Hauʻula and Lāʻie on northeast Oʻahu.

902541777.name: Waialee Beach
902541777.description: Waialeʻe Beach is a narrow North Shore coastline near Waialeʻe, east of Sunset Beach and near Turtle Bay.

904070560.name: Nanakuli Beach Park
904070560.description: Nānākuli Beach Park is a public beach park on western Oʻahu, featuring a sandy coast and recreation spaces.

904070566.name: Kahe Point
904070566.description: Kahe Point is a rocky and sandy coastline by the Kahe power plant on Oʻahu's leeward side, also known as Electric Beach.
amenities: Restrooms and showers at nearby Kahe Point Beach Park

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

904924436.name: Keaau Beach
904924436.description: Keaʻau Beach is a shoreline along Oʻahu's west coast near Keaʻau Beach Park, with sandy stretches and exposed rocky shelf.

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

904924438.name: Mākaha Beach
904924438.description: Mākaha Beach is a broad sandy West Oʻahu surfing beach with large seasonal swells.

904931357.name: ‘Ohiki-lolo Beach
904931357.description: ʻOhikilolo Beach is a secluded coast near the ʻOhikilolo area west of Mākaha on the Waiʻanae coast.

904931359.name: Mākua Beach
904931359.description: Mākua Beach is a wide and remote sandy shore on Oʻahu's west coast below Mākua Valley.

949791732.name: Palauea Beach Park
949791732.description: Palauea Beach Park provides public access to sandy White Rock Beach on Maui's southern Wailea–Mākena coast.

949791742.name: Po'olenalena Beach Park
949791742.description: Pōʻōlenalena Beach Park is a South Maui oceanfront recreation area with golden sand and views toward other islands.
hazards: Seasonal high surf and strong shorebreak

996197272.name: Aki's Beach
996197272.description: Aki's Beach is a small Oʻahu North Shore sand-and-reef beach known for occasional turtle sightings.
hazards: Protected wildlife must be left undisturbed

1005738039.name: Waimānalo Beach Park
1005738039.description: Expansive, powdery golden-white sand framed by ironwood trees and majestic views of the Koʻolau mountain range. Highly popular for bodyboarding. A favorite gathering place for local families on weekends, offering a much more spacious, less commercialized feel than Waikīkī.
hazards: Lifeguarded, but notorious for a powerful, crashing year-round shorebreak and strong backwash currents.
Car break-ins are common in parking areas (do not leave valuables visible).

1034025792.name: North Paia Beach
1034025792.description: North Pāʻia Beach is a north-shore shoreline near the town of Pāʻia, Maui.
amenities: No standalone public beach amenities confirmed

1038847727.name: Waiʻalae Beach Park
1038847727.description: Waiʻalae Beach Park is a small sandy-and-reef park beside the Kāhala coast and Waiʻalae Country Club.
hazards: Poor swimming conditions in some sections

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

1041038483.name: Barbers Point Beach Park
1041038483.description: Barbers Point Beach Park is a shoreline recreation area near Kalaeloa on southwest Oʻahu, associated with a coastal lighthouse.

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

1087770847.name: Pā'ia Secret Beach
1087770847.description: Pāʻia Secret Beach is a locally used name for a smaller Pāʻia-area shore; precise access and facility details require verification.
amenities: No developed facilities at the beach
hazards: Changes in coastal access and unstable shoreline

sources.name: Maui Ocean Center: Pāʻia Secret Beach

1090550598.name: Lē'ahi Beach
1090550598.description: Lēʻahi Beach is a rugged reef-and-sand shore below the Diamond Head volcanic landmark on Honolulu's south coast.

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

1090550600.name: Mākālei Beach
1090550600.description: Mākālei Beach is a small sandy shoreline below Diamond Head's western residential coast, near Mākālei Beach Park.

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

1090550601.name: Mākālei Beach Park
1090550601.description: Mākālei Beach Park is a small shoreline access area below the Diamond Head coast of Honolulu.

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

1092511413.name: Kapa'a Beach
1092511413.description: A rocky, rugged North Kohala coastal park offering expansive ocean views and whale-watching opportunities during winter. Rarely used for swimming due to its rocky nature, but popular with local campers and fishermen.
hazards: Extremely rocky shoreline with no sandy beach entry; rough, crashing open-ocean waves.

1093022215.name: Lehoʻula Beach
1093022215.description: Lehoʻula Beach (also mapped as Lihoʻula Beach) is a named coastline just north of Kōkī Beach in the Hāna area of East Maui. Beach access and services for this exact strip of shoreline have not been established.

1102791066.name: Maunalua Bay Beach Park
1102791066.description: Maunalua Bay Beach Park lies near Hawaiʻi Kai along sheltered Maunalua Bay, with grassy spaces overlooking the water.
hazards: Poor swimming suitability in some areas

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

1111820243.name: Kahakuloa Beach
1111820243.description: Kahakuloa Beach is near the small and remote Kahakuloa coastal community in West Maui, beneath steep green valleys.
amenities: No developed public beach-park facilities verified

1144269200.name: Miloli'i Beach Park
1144269200.description: Miloliʻi Beach Park is a coastal access area near the traditional fishing community of Miloliʻi in South Kona.

1152253817.name: Honouli Maloo Bay Beach
1152253817.description: Honouli Maloʻo Bay Beach is a mapped small coastline on eastern Molokaʻi, southwest of Hālawa and near the southeast shore. Its access, facilities, and exact ocean-entry conditions remain unverified.

1152253820.name: Halawa Beach
activities: Swimming only in calm summer conditions
1152253820.description: Hālawa Beach is on Molokaʻi's eastern end at the mouth of lush Hālawa Valley, near Kāwili and Kaili beaches.
amenities: Picnic facilities at Hālawa Beach Park
hazards: Very strong winter surf and currents

1188402259.name: Mahukona Beach Park
1188402259.description: Mahukona Beach Park is a former harbor site on the North Kohala coast, with concrete shoreline access used by experienced snorkelers and divers.

1203844859.name: Mai Poina Beach Park
1203844859.description: Mai Poina Beach Park is a public beach park on North Kīhei's shoreline along South Kīhei Road, facing Māʻalaea Bay.
hazards: Strong afternoon trade winds and wind-driven chop

1255945874.name: Hickam Harbor Beach
1255945874.description: Hickam Harbor Beach is a beach within the Joint Base Pearl Harbor–Hickam area adjacent to harbor and recreational facilities.
amenities: Access restricted to authorized base users

1256555307.name: Hickam Beach
1256555307.description: Hickam Beach is a sandy shoreline on Joint Base Pearl Harbor–Hickam, accessible according to military base rules.
amenities: Access restricted to authorized base users

1256561089.name: Fort Kamehameha Beach
1256561089.description: Fort Kamehameha Beach is a historic beachfront area near Pearl Harbor's entrance associated with the Joint Base Pearl Harbor–Hickam installation.
amenities: Access restricted to authorized base users

1283776092.name: Kahalepōhaku Beach
1283776092.description: Kahalepōhaku Beach is a remote named beach near Kahalepōhaku Point on western Molokaʻi.

1283786657.name: Poʻolau Beach
1283786657.description: Poʻolau Beach is a named coastal location on Molokaʻi; dependable beach access and facility details are not available.
hazards: Exposed winter surf and rougher currents

1283786662.name: Lighthouse Beach
1283786662.description: Lighthouse Beach is a mapped sandy shoreline on southwest Molokaʻi near ʻĪlio Point, west of Kahalepōhaku and Kamākaʻipō beaches. Current visitor facilities and public access are not confirmed.

1290308666.name: Kaiolohia Beach
1290308666.description: Kaiolohia Beach, also called Shipwreck Beach, lies on Lānaʻi's northern shoreline facing Molokaʻi; a stranded ship is visible offshore.

1290308670.name: Shipwreck Beach
1290308670.description: Shipwreck Beach on northern Lānaʻi is the exposed shore also known as Kaiolohia, with a shipwreck offshore and views of neighboring islands.

1290311243.name: Lōpā Beach
1290311243.description: Lōpā Beach is a remote shoreline along Lānaʻi's east coast, away from developed beach parks.

1296713307.name: Carlsmith Beach Park
1296713307.description: Carlsmith Beach Park, also called Four Mile, has clear tidal lagoons among lava rocks on Hilo's coast.

sources.name: Love Big Island Hilo Beach Guide

1346284947.name: Halapē Beach
1346284947.description: Halapē Beach is a very remote beach within Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park, accessible by long backcountry routes.

1347694895.name: Kahuwai Beach
1347694895.description: Kahuwai Beach lies on the rugged Hualālai/Kona Village coastline around Kahuwai Bay on Hawaiʻi Island, with lava shoreline and reef scenery.
amenities: No developed beach-park amenities identified at the bay

1576008.name: Shipwreck Beach
1576008.description: Shipwreck Beach is a sandy beach below the cliffs at Keoneloa Bay near the Grand Hyatt in Poʻipū.

1576026.name: Poʻipū Beach
1576026.description: Poʻipū Beach is a south-shore swimming and snorkeling area with a sandbar and reef-protected pools near Poʻipū Beach Park.

1576027.name: Poʻipū Beach Park
1576027.description: Poʻipū Beach Park is a major south-shore beach park with protected sandy sections and nearby snorkeling reefs.

1576102.name: Barking Sands Beach
1576102.description: Barking Sands Beach is a long west Kauaʻi shoreline near the Pacific Missile Range Facility; access to sections is restricted.

1578312.name: Lumahaʻi Beach
1578312.description: Lumahaʻi Beach is a broad sandy north-shore beach near the mouth of Lumahaʻi River, famed for scenery and powerful waves.
hazards: Very strong shorebreak and rip currents

1581352.name: Kalihiwai Beach
1581352.description: Kalihiwai Beach occupies a small bay near the mouth of Kalihiwai Stream on Kauaʻi's north shore.

1581356.name: Kauapea Beach
1581356.description: Kauapea Beach, also called Secret Beach, lies below steep coastal cliffs near Kīlauea Lighthouse on Kauaʻi.
hazards: Heavy seasonal surf and rip currents

1581357.name: Wyllie's Beach
1581357.description: Wyllie's Beach is a quiet north-shore beach reached from the Anini area by a coastal access trail.

1581358.name: Hanalei Beach
1581358.description: Hanalei Beach is the sweeping crescent of golden sand around Hanalei Bay on Kauaʻi's north shore.
amenities: Public park facilities at Black Pot and Pavilion sections

1581476.name: Moloaʻa Beach
1581476.description: Moloaʻa Beach is a secluded sandy bay at Moloaʻa on Kauaʻi's northeast coast, backed by trees.

1581478.name: Kahili Beach
1581478.description: Kahili Beach, also called Rock Quarry Beach, is a sandy beach near Kīlauea on Kauaʻi's north shore by the Kīlauea Stream mouth.

1581479.name: Waiakalua Beach
1581479.description: Waiakalua Beach is a remote beach on Kauaʻi's north shore near Kīlauea, northwest of Pilaʻa Beach.

1588229.name: Wailua Beach
1588229.description: Wailua Beach is a sandy east-coast beach at the mouth of the Wailua River near the highway.

1604572.name: Hideaways Beach
1604572.description: Hideaways Beach, also called Pali Ke Kua Beach, is a small north-shore beach beneath cliffs near Princeville.

1604573.name: Pu'u Poa Beach
1604573.description: Puʻu Poa Beach is a small sandy beach on the western side of Hanalei Bay below the Princeville resort cliffs.

1616260.name: 'Anini Beach Park
1616260.description: ʻAnini Beach Park sits on Kauaʻi's north shore beside a long fringing reef, making parts of the nearshore water relatively sheltered.

1616261.name: 'Anini Beach
1616261.description: ʻAnini Beach is a long, narrow north-shore beach protected in places by an extensive fringing reef.
amenities: Public facilities at ʻAnini Beach Park

3524264.name: Duke Paoa Kahanamoku Beach Park
3524264.description: Duke Paoa Kahanamoku Beach Park is a Waikīkī-area oceanfront recreation site associated with Duke Kahanamoku Beach near the western end of Waikīkī.
amenities: Public restrooms and showers in Waikīkī area

3743762.name: Waipio Beach
3743762.description: Waipiʻo Beach is a black-sand beach at the mouth of Waipiʻo Valley beneath steep valley cliffs.

6750000.name: Kanaha Beach Park
6750000.description: A long, windy beach park stretching along Kahului’s north shore. The global capital for Maui kiteboarding and windsurfing. Heavily impacted by trade winds, making it breezy year-round.
hazards: Lifeguard tower listed by Hawaiʻi Ocean Safety (confirm conditions and hours).
High-speed kiteboarders and windsurfers launch here; watch out for fast-moving lines and equipment on the water and sand.

9146697.name: Polihale Beach
9146697.description: Polihale Beach is a broad, remote west-side sand-and-dune beach at the end of the Na Pali coastline.
hazards: Very strong rip currents and shorebreak

9150554.name: Lydgate Beach Park
9150554.description: Lydgate Beach Park is a large east-shore park near Wailua with enclosed rock-walled ocean pools and family recreation grounds.

9155967.name: Kawailoa Beach
9155967.description: Kawailoa Bay is a sandy bay in the Māhāʻulepū coastal area on Kauaʻi’s south shore, east of Gillin’s Beach.

hazards: Coastal erosion and undercut sea cliffs

9155968.name: Gillin's Beach
9155968.description: Gillin's Beach is a relatively remote sandy stretch in the Māhāʻulepū coastal area south of Poʻipū.

10142543.name: Kawaikui Beach Park
10142543.description: Kawaikui Beach Park is a sandy-and-rocky shoreline park near ʻĀina Haina on Oʻahu's south coast.

10142588.name: Kuli'ou'ou Beach Park

sources.name: Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

11322184.name: Kawaʻaloa Beach
11322184.description: Kawaʻaloa Beach is a remote beach pocket in the Moʻomomi coastal area on northwest Molokaʻi, within a sensitive dune and shoreline habitat.

11322185.name: Kalani Beach
